resources.string: Writes your saves to a zip file you choose: a folder, a USB stick or a cloud drive such as Google Drive. Import it here or on another device.
Restores saves from a zip file made by Export saves. Each game in the file gets its saves back; the ones it had are kept aside. A running game of these saves is closed first.
%s is not a save file made by XRecomp.
Keeps your saves in your Google Drive and in step between your devices: XRecomp, a game\'s own app, another handheld.
This build of XRecomp was made without the Google sign-in that cloud saves need. The releases have it. Export saves still works: pick Google Drive as the place to write the file.
On a phone or a computer, open %1$s and type %2$s, then pick your Google account and allow XRecomp. This screen goes on by itself. A copies the code.
Opens the page in a browser here, with the code copied: paste it there, then come back.
Signs in with a code you type on google.com/device. XRecomp only gets a hidden folder of its own in your Drive: it cannot see your files, and its folder does not show among them.
Press A twice to disconnect. Your saves stay on this device and in your Drive.
Sends the saves that changed here and brings back those that changed on another device. A game whose saves changed on both sides waits for you to choose.
On: each time you come back to XRecomp, and before a game starts (its newer saves from the cloud first). Offline, games start all the same.
Saves sync only with Sync now
Its saves changed on this device and on another one since the last sync. Choose which to keep: the other ones are kept aside on this device.
Press A again within 5 seconds to disconnect your Google account.
Disconnected. Your saves are still here and in your Drive.
Cannot reach Google. Check the connection and try again.
The code expired. Connect again for a new one.
No browser here: open the page on a phone or a computer.
Cloud saves: Google signed you out. Connect again in Storage › Cloud saves.
